tools_used: provisioned documents (petition, QP, both briefs in opposition)
helpful: The concatenated brief-in-opposition.txt carrying both respondents' briefs was the most informative input: it documented the related denials and the vehicle problems.
The sal-v4 band table with bracketed reached figures made the anchor arithmetic straightforward.
gaps: CourtListener MCP search returned zero results on every query, including a known docket number, so related-docket checks (Curtis 25-1119, Boyd 26-220, Brock 26-268) could not be verified independently of the briefs.
fedcourts query has no caption or subject filter, so it cannot surface topically similar cert priors (e.g. other vaccine-mandate petitions) for a cert cell.
No published cut for grant rate conditional on a call for a response after waiver, which is the exact state this petition is in.
notes: Ranged corpus reads for the two queries: 5 GETs / 1.3 MB and 19 GETs / 5.0 MB. The MCP failure mode was silent (empty result sets, no error), which is harder to detect than an exception; a liveness probe in the sidecar would help.
